sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OFFBEAT/2026 Offbeat Collection Wholesale Rates (30%) AMENDED.pdf
documentType: Multi-day riding safari packages, not a per-night lodge rate
notes: Nett rate = 20% off Rack (not 30% like most other Offbeat properties), and explicitly excludes conservation fees despite conservation fees being listed as INCLUDED in the overall package - i.e. the 20%-off-Rack Nett math applies to a rate base that already has conservation fees folded in, per the source note 'Nett rate based on 20% of Rack rate excluding conservation fees'.
Minimum 4 people required to guarantee a safari departs (set departures); maximum 12 riders per safari; minimum age 14 years; private/tailor-made rides require minimum 5 nights.
includes: All activities (riding, game drives, walks, night drives)
All conservation fees, park fees, camping fees
Transfers associated with the safari (pick/drop Nairobi)
Dayroom in Nairobi on last day if required
Amref Flying Doctors Membership (Air-Evacuation to Nairobi)
excludes: Single Supplement: $100/night if not willing to share
Gratuities, other services, personal items, insurance

policies.deposit: 20% deposit confirms booking; balance due 45 days prior to arrival.
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded (net of bank charges); 120-46 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 45-30 days: 50% of full booking value forfeited; <30 days or no-show: 100% forfeited.
